qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits the exact five-byte, one-instruction SETE fixture at the measured RIP only when its byte destination is RSP+0x0b. The same operation at an adjacent RIP and a different displacement at the measured RIP decline.
admission.exactnessHardening: Every previously measured memory-SETcc site now also requires its exact base register and displacement instead of matching only RIP, length, condition, and width.
admission.restartability: Lazy flags materialize before the final transactional byte write. A rejected write exits to the interpreter with the original block-entry state.

verification.focusedGate: All four measured memory-SETcc tests pass.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,459 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Both zero-flag states produce interpreter-equivalent full architectural state and memory at the measured RSP+0x0b destination.
verification.negativeCoverage: The same bytes at an adjacent RIP and a one-byte displacement mutation at the measured RIP decline.
verification.sharedEmitterCoverage: The reused transactional memory-SETcc emitter retains explicit rejected-write rollback coverage.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, invalidation, and instruction totals. Absence of the measured site directly establishes bounded admission; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The measured BTF stack SETE block is absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. No native-emitter decline remains in the capped hot-site list. A05.2 remains open because 120,729 of 222,890 tier-one attempts still decline, with REP-string helpers now the dominant visible kernel frontier.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
